entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The Khan of the Jeskai, younger than the other elders, who feels like an outsider, hides her emotions, and studies history for a way to heal Tarkir.

entities.name: Shintan
entities.description: Narset's personal guard, who also watches that she observes ceremony, and who fights off the Disowned orcs beside her.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Narset's old pupil who betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai and is said to have hired the assassins.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir led by Narset, whose monks meditate and follow tradition.

entities.name: Jeskai Elders
entities.description: The older leaders of the Jeskai who appointed Narset khan and who accept the claim that the orcs were lying.

entities.name: Disowned
entities.description: Orcs exiled from the Abzan who infiltrated Jeskai territory as assassins hired by Taigam.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir, a desert folk, here in conflict with the Temur.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: The decadent clan of Tarkir that Taigam defected to.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The lawless clan of Tarkir that is aggressive toward the Jeskai.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that clashes with the Abzan.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A divided, brutal plane that Narset calls sick with war.

entities.name: Sage Eye Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold on a mountain, with a pavilion plaza for meditation a quarter-mile away and the Annals in its lowest section.

entities.name: The Annals
entities.description: Ancient scrolls and relics in the lowest section of Sage Eye, dating back a thousand years and telling of the time of the dragons.

entities.name: Way of the Wandering Warrior
entities.description: A Jeskai rite Narset undertook, during which she learned about the other clans through observation and fighting.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon connected to Tarkir in ways the khans cannot comprehend, said by some to be gone but not dead.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: A dragon Narset studies in the Annals alongside Ugin.

events.summary: Narset meditates among a hundred monks in the plaza, outwardly serene while her mind races.
events.quote: But just because I look quiet and serene doesn't mean I am.

events.summary: Narset recalls growing up an outsider who retreated into imaginary worlds, then undertaking the Way of the Wandering Warrior and being appointed khan by the elders.
events.quote: my counsel was sought out by many regarding these matters, until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai.

events.summary: Narset secretly sticks her tongue out at a bored child during meditation.
events.quote: I stuck my tongue out quickly and he covered his mouth with both hands, apparently trying to stifle a gasp.

events.summary: Narset ends the session by reciting a traditional saying that she privately dislikes.
events.quote: Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment,

events.summary: Narset slips away from her required solitary meditation, leaving a decoy with a melon for a head to fool her guard Shintan.
events.quote: I quickly constructed my decoy, dressed in the same clothes, complete with a melon for a head I had stored here the night before.

events.summary: Narset reads the Annals in the stronghold's depths, learning of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, but cannot decipher Ugin's runes.
events.quote: I learned that a dragon named Ugin was connected to Tarkir in ways the khans couldn't comprehend, and that some had claimed Ugin was gone, but not dead.

events.summary: Returning to the pavilion, Narset finds eight Disowned orcs holding Shintan and her decoy destroyed.
events.quote: I made it to the rock face and climbed back up to the pavilion to find eight Abzan orcs standing within.

events.summary: Narset ambushes the orcs, killing one with a palm strike to the heart, kicking two, and turning their commander against his own soldiers.
events.quote: I landed in front of the orc and spun around, striking left of the center of the orc's chest, having timed his heart's pumping to stop it with my palm.

events.summary: Shintan frees himself and defeats his captors, and the two end the fight with orcs dead and wounded on the marble floor.
events.quote: The orcs lay, some dead, all bleeding, on the marble floor of the sacred temple.

events.summary: Shintan reports that an orc said Taigam hired them in revenge for an assassination attempt Narset allegedly sent; Narset denies knowing of any assassins.
events.quote: He said he and his kin were hired by the rat Taigam.

events.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.
Narset meditates atop a mountain peak, stops seeking an answer, and begins to dream of the worlds from her youth.
events.quote: The worlds from my youth rush toward me.

relations.note: She is khan of the Jeskai.
relations.quote: Narset is the Khan of the Jeskai.

relations.note: He is her personal guard, though he also serves the elders.
relations.quote: My personal guard, Shintan, nodded at me from the edge of the pavilion.

relations.note: Her former pupil who betrayed the Jeskai for the Sultai and is said to have sent the assassins.
relations.quote: Taigam, my old pupil, who had betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai
who had betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai

relations.note: The orcs claim Taigam hired them.
relations.quote: all told the same tale, that Taigam had hired them as retribution for an assassination attempt.

relations.note: She fights and kills several of the orc assassins.
relations.quote: I had no weapons, but I had the element of surprise and years of training on these would-be assassins.

relations.note: Orcs exiled from the Abzan, not true Abzan.
relations.quote: these orc were not true Abzan, but Disowned—those exiled from the Abzan.
